explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/771 (Erdős–Graham): f(n) is maximal such that for every m ≥ 1 there is S ⊆ {1,…,n} with |S| = f(n) and m ≠ Σ_{a∈A} a for all A ⊆ S; is f(n) = (1/2 + o(1))·n/log n? Yes (Erdős–Graham lower bound, Alon–Freiman upper bound). In Lean IsAdmissible n k is exactly the condition for size k, f n is the largest admissible k, and the statement is f(n) ~ n/(2 log n), equivalent to (1/2 + o(1))n/log n. Faithful.
